extraction.Name: Mary Julia Neiss Whirlwind Soldier
extraction.Buyer: I sold the land to Ella McHenry, at least she is the one who paid me the money and a note for $500.00. The records show that you sold this land to Kenneth Sellers.
extraction.NOTES: Formerly Mary Julia Neiss. Was supposed to get $2900 but actually received $2400.00 in cash and a note for $500.00; Ella McHenry paid $25.00 at one time and $5.00 another making a grand total of $2430.00. Allottee and husband went to see McHenry on two occasions to collect on the note but she said she could not pay it. Signed deed for McHenry but noted there could have been another person's name in the deed. Did not sign a receipt for the patent. Patent was mailed to allottee in 1920. Five children depend on allottee and husband. Notary: as. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32. Document sworn June 25, 1929.
